title: Cheat Sheet - Dear ImGui
markdown:
## The frame

```cpp-norun
ImGui_ImplDX11_NewFrame();
ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
ImGui::NewFrame();
// ... your UI ...
ImGui::Render();
ImGui_ImplDX11_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData());
```

Before your game uses input: `if (!ImGui::GetIO().WantCaptureMouse) { ... }`, likewise `WantCaptureKeyboard`.

## Windows

| Code | Does |
|---|---|
| `if (ImGui::Begin("Name", &open, flags)) { ... } ImGui::End();` | A window; `End` always runs |
| `ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(400, 300), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);` | Size on first use only |
| `ImGui::BeginChild("id", ImVec2(0, 200), ImGuiChildFlags_Borders); ... ImGui::EndChild();` | A scrolling region |
| `ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar`, `_AlwaysAutoResize`, `_MenuBar`, `_NoSavedSettings` | Common flags |

## Widgets

| Code | Returns true when |
|---|---|
| `ImGui::Button("Save")` | Clicked |
| `ImGui::Checkbox("Visible", &visible)` | Toggled |
| `ImGui::SliderFloat("Speed", &speed, 0.0f, 10.0f, "%.1f")` | Value changed |
| `ImGui::DragInt("Count", &count, 1.0f, 0, 100)` | Value changed |
| `ImGui::InputText("Name", buf, sizeof(buf))` | Text changed |
| `ImGui::Combo("Mode", &index, items, count)` | Selection changed |
| `ImGui::Selectable("Item", selected)` | Clicked |
| `ImGui::ColorEdit4("Tint", &color.x)` | Colour changed |
| `ImGui::TreeNode("Node")` ... `ImGui::TreePop()` | Open (call TreePop only then) |
| `ImGui::CollapsingHeader("Section")` | Open (no pop) |

After a widget: `IsItemHovered()`, `IsItemActive()`, `IsItemActivated()`, `IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()`, `SetItemTooltip("...")`.

## IDs

| Code | Does |
|---|---|
| `"Delete##row7"` | Shows "Delete", ID includes "row7" |
| `"Score: 12###score"` | Shows the text, ID is only "score" |
| `ImGui::PushID(i); ... ImGui::PopID();` | Unique IDs per row or object |

## Layout

| Code | Does |
|---|---|
| `ImGui::SameLine();` | Next widget on the same line |
| `ImGui::Separator();`, `Spacing();`, `Dummy(size)` | Line, gap, empty space |
| `ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(120);` | Width of the next widget |
| `ImGui::BeginGroup(); ... ImGui::EndGroup();` | Treat several widgets as one item |
| `ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail()` | Space left in the window |

## Tables

```cpp-norun
if (ImGui::BeginTable("t", 3, ImGuiTableFlags_Borders | ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable | ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollY))
{
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Name"); ImGui::TableSetupColumn("HP"); ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Pos");
    ImGui::TableSetupScrollFreeze(0, 1);
    ImGui::TableHeadersRow();
    for (auto& e : rows) { ImGui::TableNextRow(); ImGui::TableNextColumn(); ImGui::TextUnformatted(e.name); /* ... */ }
    ImGui::EndTable();
}
```

Sorting: `ImGuiTableSortSpecs* s = ImGui::TableGetSortSpecs(); if (s && s->SpecsDirty) { sort; s->SpecsDirty = false; }`

## Menus, popups and modals

| Code | Does |
|---|---|
| `BeginMainMenuBar` / `BeginMenu("File")` / `MenuItem("Save", "Ctrl+S")` | Menus |
| `ImGui::OpenPopup("id");` then `if (ImGui::BeginPopup("id")) { ... ImGui::EndPopup(); }` | A popup |
| `if (ImGui::BeginPopupContextItem()) { ... ImGui::EndPopup(); }` | Right-click menu on the last item |
| `BeginPopupModal("Unsaved changes", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize)` | A modal; `CloseCurrentPopup()` to close |
| `ImGui::Shortcut(ImGuiMod_Ctrl \| ImGuiKey_S)` | A keyboard shortcut |

## Drag and drop

```cpp-norun
if (ImGui::BeginDragDropSource()) { ImGui::SetDragDropPayload("ITEM", &index, sizeof(int)); ImGui::Text("Move"); ImGui::EndDragDropSource(); }
if (ImGui::BeginDragDropTarget()) { if (auto* p = ImGui::AcceptDragDropPayload("ITEM")) { int from = *static_cast<const int*>(p->Data); } ImGui::EndDragDropTarget(); }
```

## Drawing

```cpp-norun
ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
dl->AddRectFilled(a, b, IM_COL32(40, 120, 200, 255), 4.0f);
dl->AddLine(a, b, IM_COL32_WHITE, 2.0f);
dl->AddText(p, IM_COL32_WHITE, "label");
dl->PushClipRect(min, max, true); /* ... */ dl->PopClipRect();
```

## Docking, style and settings

```cpp-norun
io.ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_DockingEnable;      // turn on docking (docking branch)
ImGui::DockSpaceOverViewport();                        // the main window becomes a dock space
ImGui::StyleColorsDark();                              // or PushStyleColor / PopStyleColor
io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF("font.ttf", 16.0f);       // before the first frame
io.IniFilename = "tools.ini";                          // or nullptr for no saving
```
